# ADR-3017: A02: HSTS max-age configuration for site family 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Missing HSTS allows SSL stripping on first visit.

## Decision

Public sites MUST set an HSTS max-age configuration for site family 5 (A02-5).

## Consequences

Preload is evaluated per brand domain.
